1.web: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.
1.asv: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I gave order to the churches of Galatia, so also do ye.

2.web: On the first day of the week, let each one of you save, as he may prosper, that no collections be made when I come.
2.asv: Upon the first day of the week let each one of you lay by him in store, as he may prosper, that no collections be made when I come.

3.web: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
3.asv: And when I arrive, whomsoever ye shall approve, them will I send with letters to carry your bounty unto Jerusalem:

4.web: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.
4.asv: and if it be meet for me to go also, they shall go with me.

5.web: But I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.
5.asv: But I will come unto you, when I shall have passed through Macedonia; for I pass through Macedonia;

6.web: But with you it may be that I will stay, or even winter, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.
6.asv: but with you it may be that I shall abide, or even winter, that ye may set me forward on my journey whithersoever I go.

7.web: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.
7.asv: For I do not wish to see you now by the way; for I hope to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

8.web: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,
8.asv: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost;

9.web: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.
9.asv: for a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.

10.web: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
10.asv: Now if Timothy come, see that he be with you without fear; for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do:

11.web: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.
11.asv: let no man therefore despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come unto me: for I expect him with the brethren.

12.web: Now concerning Apollos, the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers; and it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.
12.asv: But as touching Apollos the brother, I besought him much to come unto you with the brethren: and it was not at all his will to come now; but he will come when he shall have opportunity.

13.web: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
13.asv: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

14.web: Let all that you do be done in love.
14.asv: Let all that ye do be done in love.

15.web: Now I beg you, brothers (you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints),
15.asv: Now I beseech you, brethren (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to minister unto the saints),

16.web: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.
16.asv: that ye also be in subjection unto such, and to every one that helpeth in the work and laboreth.

17.web: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.
17.asv: And I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they supplied.

18.web: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.
18.asv: For they refreshed my spirit and yours: acknowledge ye therefore them that are such.

19.web: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you much in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.
19.asv: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Prisca salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.

20.web: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
20.asv: All the brethren salute you. Salute one another with a holy kiss.

21.web: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.
21.asv: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.

22.web: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be accursed. Come, Lord!
22.asv: If any man loveth not the Lord, let him be anathema. Maranatha.

23.web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
23.asv: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

24.web: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
24.asv: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
